name: Pepsi Cola
claims: Younger, bolder taste. Sweeter profile than Coke. Heavy music and entertainment sponsorships. Pepsi Challenge positioning around taste tests.
target: General consumers, younger demographics, entertainment venues

name: Pepsi Zero Sugar
claims: Zero sugar cola that claims to not sacrifice taste. Targets health-conscious cola drinkers who still want cola flavor.

name: Dr Pepper
claims: Unique 23-flavor blend. Positioned as the alternative for people who find standard cola too plain. Cult-like consumer loyalty.
target: Flavor-seekers, loyal fans, consumers who reject Coke/Pepsi binary

name: Red Bull
claims: Gives you wings. Premium positioning. Dominant sports and extreme event sponsorships. Slim can perceived as sophisticated.
target: Athletes, students, professionals, event venues, airlines

name: Monster Energy
claims: Unleash the beast. Wider flavor variety than Red Bull. Strong gaming and motorsports presence. Lower price point than Red Bull.
target: Gamers, younger males, venues seeking lower-cost energy option

name: Gatorade
claims: Science-backed hydration and electrolyte replenishment. Dominant in team sports sponsorships. Endorsed by top professional athletes.

name: Prime Hydration
claims: Logan Paul and KSI co-founded. Viral with Gen Z. No artificial colors or flavors. Heavy social media marketing.
target: Gen Z, schools, gyms, venues wanting novelty appeal

name: Liquid Death
claims: Murder your thirst. Canned mountain water with punk/irreverent branding. Strong anti-plastic sustainability angle.
target: Health-conscious consumers, counter-culture audiences, venues wanting a conversation piece
